headline: OAK @ LAA matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is OAK 3.98 at LAA 4.91, with a projected total of 8.89. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward OAK: OAK moved -0.50 runs while LAA moved -1.04, changing the projected margin by +0.54 runs. The projected total fell -1.54, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +11.6%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Reid Detmers has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Donovan Walton, Zach Neto, Henry Bolte, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Colby Thomas because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
